A field guide to an inhabited world · volume IV · the fox family

Kitsune

Five fox monster girls who count their trust in tails. A wild kitsune has one. Win her over and she grows more, up to three; a devoted elder can grow nine. Red, arctic, fennec, corsac and gray fox: tricksters, diggers and wanderers, and every one of them carries foxfire.

The central similarity

Tails are trust.

Every kitsune shows how much she trusts you, in the number of tails she lets you see. That makes the bond the most visible of any family. They are also tricksters: a kitsune tests people with games, and how you play decides how she feels.

  • One, two, three tailsOne tail when wild, two at high friendship (25), three when devoted (60).
  • Nine tailsTen days at full devotion turns her into a kyubi elder: nine tails and a foxfire lantern.
  • The stash gameShe steals small things and buries them nearby. Find the stash and laugh it off, and she loves you for it.
  • FoxfireFloating blue-green flames that light the way at night (real light).

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a kitsune builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Sweet berries, glow berries, cooked chicken, fish
  • Finding her stash and taking it in good humour (+3)
  • Petting (she leans into it)
  • Leaving her earth alone

What costs trust

  • Hitting her, especially over a stolen item
  • Digging up her earth
  • Taking food from her stash of berries

Devoted (60+)

Three tails and foxfire that follows you at night. Ten days at full devotion: nine tails (the kyubi), a foxfire lantern around her (light level 12) and a bigger decoy trick.

Mating & young

FormLive kits in an earth (den). YoungKits (3-4), grown in 5 days. WhereA bank of grass, dirt, sand or snow within 24 blocks. Kits use the adult model at 45% scale with a bigger head; they always show one tail except to their father.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship, on a night you sleep, she may curl up in your bed with her tails around you. By morning she is expecting, and her belly rounds out over the day.
2. The earthShe digs an earth (a den): a short tunnel into a grassy or sandy bank with a den block at the end, lined with grass. Snowy foxes dig into snow banks.
3. KitsThree or four kits are born in the earth, her species, each in a random colour of it, each with one tail. They stay near the earth and play, and pounce on everything that moves.
4. GrownGrown in five days, devoted to their father from the first day (full affection, and so already three-tailed for him).

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

TailsThe tail count is the bond meter made visible: tail_1 to tail_9 are bones the renderer shows by bond. She shows the tails of her strongest bond, so everyone sees how far her favourite has come.
The stash gameA wild or curious kitsune sometimes sneaks up and snatches an ordinary item from your hand (never tools, weapons or armour). She buries it within 12 blocks, with a wisp of foxfire marking the spot. Dig it up within a day and she laughs and runs circles round you (+3). Hit her for it and she remembers.
FoxfireAt night a kitsune of two or more tails carries foxfire: real light (the vanilla light block, placed and removed as she moves) and blue-green flames. A bonded one lights your path.
Mouse pounceShe listens, then dives head-first into grass or snow to catch rabbits, chickens and fish (the vanilla fox pounce, bigger).
DecoyHurt and frightened, she leaves an illusion of herself behind and slips away. The decoy vanishes in a puff of foxfire when hit.
Dusk and dawnKitsune sleep curled up under trees by day and are busiest at dusk and dawn. They love sweet berries, glow berries and cooked chicken above all.

Species profiles

Forests, plains & villagesTrickster · bold

Red Fox (about 1.75 blocks)

TemperamentMischievous, bold, quick-witted

Ecology & behaviourThe archetype: lives on the edge of everything, raids chicken coops, plays the stash game more than any other fox and leaves decoys behind when chased.

Signature: Master of illusionsHer decoy lasts longer and she can leave two. At three tails she plays the stash game with you on purpose: she hides a small present (an emerald, a gold nugget, sweet berries) instead of stealing.

Player interactionPlay along. Keep valuables out of your hands near her and laugh when you find her stash.

Snowy plains & iceHardy · cheerful

Arctic Fox (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentHardy, cheerful, endlessly hungry

Ecology & behaviourRound, fluffy and built for cold: short ears, a thick coat and a tail she sleeps under like a blanket. She hears prey under the snow and dives in after it, and follows polar bears to scavenge.

Signature: Snow dive & cold-proofNever freezes, walks on powder snow, and dives into snow blocks to catch hidden prey (rabbits, silverfish). A bonded arctic fox curled in your bed keeps you from freezing all night.

Player interactionFeed her: arctic foxes are always hungry and always grateful.

Fennec (about 1.35 blocks)

TemperamentChatty, social, very easily delighted

Ecology & behaviourThe smallest fox, with the biggest ears: they shed heat and hear prey under the sand. Lives in family groups, digs elaborate burrows, and sleeps through the hot day.

Signature: Desert diggerShe digs fast in sand and sometimes turns things up: bones, gold nuggets, pottery sherds, an occasional emerald. A bonded fennec digs for you and brings what she finds.

Player interactionBring water and sweet berries to her burrow at dusk.

Corsac Fox (about 1.7 blocks)

TemperamentShy, nomadic, sociable with her own kind

Ecology & behaviourWanders the open steppe in small groups, follows herds and caravans (llamas, wandering traders) for scraps, and never digs her own earth if she can borrow one.

Signature: WayfinderA bonded corsac always knows the way home: at night, when you are more than 64 blocks from your bed, she trots towards it and waits for you, leaving a trail of foxfire.

Player interactionTravel with her. Follow the wandering trader she is following.

Gray Fox (about 1.65 blocks)

TemperamentQuiet, secretive, unexpectedly brave

Ecology & behaviourThe only fox that climbs trees, with hooked claws like a cat's. She rests in hollows and on branches, drops onto prey from above, and is rarely seen on the ground.

Signature: Tree climberShe climbs logs and leaves like a ladder, perches in the canopy and drops onto prey (or onto zombies threatening her bonded player).

Player interactionLook up. Leave food on a branch or a log.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Tails by her strongest bond (1/2/3, nine as a kyubi)
  • The stash game (steals a plain item, buries it under foxfire; digging it up gives +3)
  • Foxfire: real light at night from two tails
  • Pounce on rabbits and wild-fox chicken raids
  • Decoys when badly hurt (two for the red fox)
  • Arctic fox: no freezing, walks on powder snow
  • Fennec digs finds out of sand
  • Corsac wayfinder at night
  • Gray fox climbs walls and trees
  • Litter of 3-4 kits
  • Kitsune Obaa: nine tails always; befriended, once a day she hides her friend from the monsters closing in
  • Dunefennec: her friend near her runs fast on sand, and husks near her lose interest in her friend
  • Huli jing: nine tails always; with villagers about, her friend near her has Hero of the Village
  • Vulphea: fireproof, her bite burns; once a day a killing blow leaves only ashes, and she rises from them a minute later
  • Wattlefox: fireproof; befriended, she puts out fires near her friend and plants acacia saplings on open ground
  • One wild kitsune in four is born with two or three tails (rarely up to five)

Not yet

  • Digging an earth (den) for the kits
  • The arctic fox's dive into snow
  • The gray fox dropping onto prey from trees

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • The silver fox is a colour of the red fox, not a species (it is the same animal).
  • Tails are bones tail_1..tail_9 shown by the renderer; one model per species covers every tail count.
  • Foxfire light uses the vanilla light block, so it needs no shader or client mod.

Open questions

  • Should the nine-tailed elder be able to spawn naturally (very rarely) in cherry groves?
  • Should the stash game work on other mobs' drops too?
